h1: SEO for Auto Repair Shops That Fills Bays, Not Just Traffic
meta: SEO for auto repair shops: rank higher for glass, brakes, oil, tires, transmission and detailing searches. More calls, more booked jobs.
subhead: One playbook for the whole trade: glass, brakes, oil, tires, transmissions, detailing.

faqs.q: My shop does everything. Do I need separate pages for each service?
faqs.a: Yes, and this is the single most common mistake I fix. A driver searching for brake pad replacement cost does not want your homepage. They want a page about brake pads. Google matches specific searches to specific pages, so one catch all services page ranks for almost nothing. Dedicated pages for your money services win every time.

faqs.q: How fast can an auto repair shop see results from SEO?
faqs.a: Profile and review work can move the map pack within weeks, which matters most for urgent searches like windshield replacement or brake repair. Durable organic rankings for competitive service terms typically take three to six months. Auto intent is so urgent that even early visibility turns into calls fast.

faqs.q: Should I put prices on my website?
faqs.a: In ranges, yes. Drivers searching for costs are telling you exactly what they want to know, and shops that publish honest starting prices get the call while shops hiding behind contact us for pricing get skipped. Ranges also pre qualify callers.

faqs.q: Can a single shop really beat the national chains on Google?
faqs.a: Locally, yes, and I do it by refusing to fight on their terms. Chains rank with thin location pages, ignore reviews at the store level, and bury their coupons. A single shop with a living profile, real service pages, and visible offers outranks them in its own backyard.

faqs.q: Do reviews really matter that much for auto repair?
faqs.a: More than almost any other factor. Reviews that mention specifics, honest pricing, same day service, fixed right the first time, convert far better than generic five star reviews.

faqs.q: I already run Google Ads. Do I still need SEO?
faqs.a: Ads rent the top spot and stop the day you stop paying, often at brutal cost per click in auto terms. SEO builds an asset that keeps producing calls without a per click meter running. Most shops run both for a while, then let SEO carry more of the load as rankings compound.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to get started?
faqs.a: Access to your website, your Google Business Profile, and an hour on which services make you money. I handle the rest.
